Let's Skip The Pathos

Hub

Presenting an image generator that runs on the text-to-image plugin and depends entirely on it. It is completely free, with AI prompt enhancement (Q&A style), and everything else you already know. Enjoy watching your fantasies come to life in pixels.

I don't mean to sound closed off or arrogant, so please take this text simply as a fact without any subtext. Tornado is a relaunch of AIMG+, which I wrote and continue to maintain. I didn't 'take over' management from anyone or anything like that. This project is personally mine and was written from scratch (not counting the base of 'AI Image Generator', so it is essentially a fork of it, but it is my personal fork, and no one else participated in its code, neither at the beginning nor now). Again, don't interpret this text as anything profound, it's just a warning that Tornado is solely my project. And by the way, Tornado uses its own fork of the t2i v2 plugin - 'TRON', but it is also completely based on t2i v2 from Perchance. The core of this plugin is of course not written by me but belongs to the author of Perchance, so Tornado (just like AIMG+ used to be) is a fork that I have heavily customized.
